speakers.speaker: klemens-strasser
speakers.role: Indie Developer, 2 x Finalist and 1 x Winner of Apple Design Award
speakers.bio: Klemens recently launched his app called StudySnacks, Turn learning 🧑‍🎓 into a tasty game. Check out his apps at https://strasser.app/

speakers.speaker: carola-nitz
speakers.bio: Carola Nitz is an iOS developer who’s shaped apps like Netflix and VLC 📱. Passionate about connecting with the community, she founded Women Who Code Berlin.

speakers.speaker: christian-selig
speakers.bio: Christian is known for creating innovative apps such as Apollo (1M+ downloads), Juno for Apple Vision Pro 🥽, and PixelPals 🐾. A former Apple engineer, his deep expertise in design sets him apart in the iOS community.

speakers.speaker: paul-hudson
speakers.role: Author & Educator at Hacking with Swift
speakers.bio:
Paul Hudson has taught thousands of developers Swift through Hacking with Swift, a go-to platform for coders worldwide. 📚

From tech journalism to building apps, Paul has written over 20 books and developed tools for companies like Apple and Fender. When he’s not coding, you’ll find him solving Rubik’s cubes or spending time with his dogs. 🐕

speakers.speaker: jane-chao
speakers.bio:
Jane is making coding accessible and engaging for Swift developers, with over 9,000 subscribers on her growing YouTube channel 🎬 ChaoCode.

She’s currently building Simple LLM, a macOS chatbot designed for iOS enthusiasts, integrating OpenAI and open-source models with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation for smarter responses 🤯.

A fan of SwiftUI and experienced in backend development on Google Cloud Platform, Jane’s bilingual tutorials in Chinese are inspiring a new generation of coders to dive into iOS development and tech 💻.

speakers.speaker: donny-wals
speakers.bio: Donny, an iOS engineer with a passion for learning and teaching. He will unravel the mysteries of tasks, actors, and structured concurrency. He blogs at https://www.donnywals.com.

speakers.speaker: daniel-steinberg
speakers.bio:
Author of A SwiftUI Kickstart and founder of Dim Sum Thinking has guided developers in iOS and Mac programming since the earliest days of the platform. Known for his clear, practical approach to Swift, SwiftUI, and Functional Programming, Daniel’s sessions are a must for developers looking to deepen their skills.

When not coding or teaching, he indulges in his passion for cooking and baking, particularly bread making.

speakers.speaker: riana-soumi
speakers.bio:
An iOS engineer with a sharp eye for clean, efficient coding.

Riana blends full-stack know-how with a deep focus on modern iOS and Swift practices. Fresh from her debut at DeNA TechCon, where she unpacked the secrets to effective unit testing, she’s ready to bring her expertise to iOSConfSG.

From crafting powerful iOS solutions to exploring the world as a traveler and content creator, Riana’s journey fuels her approach to development.

Join her to get practical Swift Testing insights that go beyond code and push you to think differently.

speakers.speaker: alex-ozun
speakers.bio:
Alex leads mobile development for millions of users. Known for his expertise in advanced Swift and functional programming, Alex is here to share practical strategies for managing side effects - making them explicit, controlled, and type-safe.

From debugging to reusability, he’ll show how to harness Swift’s type system to simplify complex functions and create cleaner, more predictable code.

Don’t miss this deep dive, perfect for senior iOS devs.

Alex also writes articles on advanced Swift topics at https://swiftology.io.

speakers.speaker: charlie-chapman
speakers.bio: When I’m not doing my day job as Developer Advocate at RevenueCat, I develop an indie iOS app called Dark Noise and podcasting at LaunchedFM.

speakers.speaker: dai-ming
speakers.bio:
Known for “Learn iOS Programming with Dai Ming” and “GeekTime’s iOS Development Master Course", Dai Ming has driven iOS performance at top companies like Kuaishou, Alibaba, and Didi. From mastering compilation to optimizing every detail on iOS and macOS, his insights are a game-changer.

Catch Dai Ming at iOSConfSG - this is one session you won’t want to miss.

speakers.speaker: he-ye
speakers.bio: Experienced Software Engineer with a history of working in the information technology and service industry. Skilled in Swift, Java, Mobile Development, and Agile Methodologies.

speakers.speaker: jasper-nguyen
speakers.bio:
A seasoned Mobile Engineering leader with a proven track record of building innovative mobile platforms that drive user engagement and business growth. From leading large engineering teams at fast-paced fintech and tech companies to designing scalable, high-performance mobile apps, I am passionate about turning complex challenges into impactful products.

I thrive in dynamic environments, leading cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of innovation, and driving the development of high-impact products. Outside of work, I’m dedicated to continuous learning, mentoring the next generation of engineers, and staying at the forefront of mobile trends and blockchain technologies.

speakers.speaker: jeff-watkins
speakers.bio:
Fleeing the land of Starbucks Coffee and ridiculously-hopped beer (Seattle) with his wife and five cats, Jeff Watkins has found tranquility beside the Water of Leith in Stockbridge, Edinburgh. There he spends his time coaching folks through career transitions, mentoring developers, and teaching public speaking workshops. Somehow he still finds time for roleplaying and killing robot dinosaurs.

Jeff has been building software for more than three decades and is currently an engineering manager for Goodnotes. He is a ten year veteran of Apple and has worked on core iOS frameworks and apps delivered via the App Store. It’s not his fault Game Center had either green felt or “those bubbles”.

speakers.speaker: kosala-jayasekara
speakers.bio: Kosala is a seasoned iOS developer with over a decade of experience and a passion for empowering the tech community. Through global workshops, his YouTube channel, and consulting services, he shares insights on the Apple ecosystem and helps companies overcome tech challenges worldwide.

speakers.speaker: krzysztof-zablocki
speakers.bio: As a Principal Swift Engineer, Krzysztof is shaping the future of Apple platforms with tools adopted by 80K+ teams, from Apple to Disney. 🏆 2x Engineering Emmy winner, co-founder of Pixle, and creator of Foldify & Sourcery for Xcode.

speakers.speaker: monika-mateska
speakers.bio: Monika is an iOS Engineer at Vivino with a strong background in Augmented Reality and a passion for Mixed Reality innovation. She is the founder of CocoaHeadsMK and the organizer of iOSKonfMK, an international iOS conference held in Macedonia, dedicated to bringing together developers and enthusiasts to share insights and advance the iOS community.

speakers.speaker: mustafa-yusuf
speakers.bio:
The incredible indie developer who is making waves with his apps Tasks and Karo.

Both apps have been featured by Apple and have achieved an impressive total of over half a million downloads.

Mustafa has received several accolades, including "The Shippies" award for Karo. He also had the honour of being a keynote speaker at the grand opening of Apple’s Developer Center in Bangalore. As a pioneer in app development since the early days of Swift, he is at the forefront of innovation.

His journey is filled with insightful experiences that will inspire every Swift developer.

speakers.speaker: priyal-porwal
speakers.bio: Priyal is Senior iOS Engineer at Salesforce. She loves sharing knowledge and learnings through speaking at conferences, meetups and workshops. She is passionate about accessibility, application security, testability and animations. You can catch her traveling, trekking, watching movies or enjoying cooking when she’s not coding.

speakers.speaker: ryan-forsyth
speakers.bio: iOS developer focused on building user-friendly apps through rapid prototyping with Swift and Apple SDKs. My curiosity drives me to explore creative solutions that address real-world challenges.

speakers.speaker: vijay-tholpadi
speakers.bio: A seasoned iOS Engineer with a decade of experience, Vijay spearheads Developer Experience (DevX) initiatives and iOS team productivity at Carousell. As a contributor to Tuist, he's passionate about elevating iOS development workflows drawing inspiration from Android and Web platforms.

speakers.speaker: vince-davis
speakers.role: Senior iOS Developer at United Airlines
speakers.bio: Vince has been doing iOS for over 8 years. He enjoys all things SwiftUI and Apple related... Maybe not all things. When he is not coding you can find him traveling, trying to knock another country off his bucket list.
